name: Ichabod
title: The Child Without Glory
summary: Ichabod was the son of Phinehas and grandson of the priest Eli. He was born on the day the ark of the covenant was captured by the Philistines, when his father and grandfather died. His name means 'the glory has departed from Israel,' given by his dying mother as a symbol of the loss of God's glory.

keyEvents.title: The Ark of the Covenant Is Captured
keyEvents.description: The Philistines defeated Israel in the battle at Aphek and captured the ark of the covenant. Eli's two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were killed in the fighting.

keyEvents.title: The Death of Eli
keyEvents.description: When Eli heard the news that the ark of the covenant had been taken and that his two sons were dead, he fell backward from his chair, broke his neck, and died.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Ichabod
keyEvents.description: Phinehas' wife was heavily pregnant and in labor when she heard about the ark and the death of her father-in-law and husband. She gave birth to a son in her final moments.

keyEvents.title: Naming – The Glory Has Departed
keyEvents.description: The dying mother named the child Ichabod and said, 'The glory has departed from Israel,' because God's ark had been captured and her father-in-law and husband were dead.

keyEvents.title: Ichabod Mentioned in the Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ichabod is mentioned as the brother of Ahitub, who was the father of Ahijah, a priest who served under King Saul. This shows that the lineage continued despite the tragedy.
